background: Goldman Sachs Bank USA is the US deposit-taking bank of The Goldman Sachs Group, holding the firm's lending, derivatives and Marcus consumer deposits, funded by deposits and by the parent.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ on average across all three main agencies, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratios are strong for a US bank: CET1 of 13.5% is above the peer median, and leverage of 7.7% and LCR of 126% are both in the top quarter. CET1 has fallen 2.8 points since 30 Jun 2025, a big move that shows the bank is being run with less capital than before. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days, leaving a well-capitalised bank inside a markets-driven group.
